## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the green bottle with white label on the table and raise it.

Task description: Pick up the white-label green bottle lying horizontally on the table. This round, use the left arm to lift it and move it toward the upper area on the left side of the scene.

Success criteria: Lift the green bottle clearly off the table and move it to an outer position on the robot's left. Moving it left only near the tabletop does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping a regular cylindrical section of the bottle body, avoiding the cap, tapered shoulder, and uneven base. Orient the fingers’ opening and closing direction close to perpendicular to the bottle’s long axis to reduce slipping.
- When approaching from above, leave finger-to-table clearance and use the live camera to confirm the bottle body lies within the effective grasping range before closing. If its position is unclear, adjust slightly and inspect again to reduce pushing it into a roll.
- Use a small movement during the initial lift to confirm the bottle moves with the gripper without slipping, then transport it toward the upper left.
